highlights.title: ASML Raises Full-Year Sales Outlook
highlights.description: ASML upgraded the low end of its 2026 sales forecast as increasing artificial intelligence spending boosts demand for the Dutch company’s chip-making machines. The firm projected annual sales of between €44 billion ($49 billion) and €45 billion this year. ASML's outlook offers an indication of investment plans by chipmakers like TSMC, Samsung Electronics and Intel. Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: DeepL CEO on Voice AI Growth and Competition
highlights.description: DeepL CEO Jarek Kutylowski discusses surging demand for voice-to-voice translation and how AI is transforming global business. He also addresses competition with OpenAI and Anthropic, DeepL’s AWS strategy, European data sovereignty, recent workforce cuts and why the company is comfortable remaining private. He spoke with Bloomberg’s Tom Mackenzie, at the International AI Summit in Dublin, Ireland. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: OpenAI, Google pushing new AI models easily tricked into making nudes, researchers say
highlights.description: Attack method exposes flaws in OpenAI, Google safeguards against AI nudes.

highlights.title: Ark's Wood Favors Nvidia, AMD in 'Volatile' Chip Cycle
highlights.description: Cathie Wood, founder, CEO and CIO of Ark Investment Management, discusses why she avoids traditional memory-chip players, saying the business cycle is "most volatile." Speaking on Bloomberg Television, Wood adds that we are "just at the beginning" of the artificial intelligence revolution. "In terms of our semiconductor exposure, [we] tend to be at the less-cyclical end of the spectrum," she adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: MAIA: Interview of Guillaume Princen on Anthropic’s AI Strategy
highlights.description: In an interview on October 14, 2026, Anthropic’s Head of International Startups & Digital Native, Guillaume Princen, discussed how startups and major firms are adopting Anthropic’s AI, including Claude tools, to boost employee productivity, overhaul processes, and build new products. He highlighted growing demand for frontier models like Opus 5.5, now about 40% cheaper than its predecessor, and a shift toward using different models for specific tasks across the 5.5 family. Princen emphasized Ant

highlights.title: FBI arrests Saudi OpenAI employee who allegedly planted recording device in conference room
highlights.description: The Tuesday incident comes as the ChatGPT-maker, along with competitors, faces heightened scrutiny over its safety practices.

highlights.title: OpenAI May Hold Back Next Generation Model for Checks, CFO Says
highlights.description: OpenAI Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar discusses artificial intelligence security concerns, telling Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie that the firm is "doubling down" on safety and alignment, and is holding back its next generation model while it carries out checks. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Anthropic urges court in Washington, DC, to rehear appeal of Pentagon blacklisting
highlights.description: Anthropic is asking a federal court in Washington, D.C., to rehear its appeal in a case concerning the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models.

highlights.title: Anthropic Executive Says Open-Source AI Models Are Higher Risk
highlights.description: Anthropic PBC’s top sales executive outside the US argued that open alternatives to its AI models carry “more risk” of cybersecurity incidents or other dangers.

highlights.title: Nvidia GPU prices spike in Japan; prices up to 41% higher than Amazon US
highlights.description: A Japanese retailer has increased the prices of RTX 50-series GPUs between 12.71% and 41.10%, with the mainstream models bearing the brunt of the price increases.

chips_cloud.description: Asian data center operator Princeton Digital Group Ltd. is seeking a syndicated loan of up to $1.2 billion to fund its Malaysia buildout, according to a person familiar with the matter, as the debt binge to finance artificial intelligence infrastructure continues.

ev_autonomous.description: Nine years after its reveal, the overdue Roadster is set to debut on Thursday to an EV market that has grown skeptical of electric hypercars.

ev_autonomous.title: Tesla is unveiling the new Roadster for real this time, promise
ev_autonomous.description: Tesla says it will finally stream its next-generation Roadster event this Thursday, October 15, at 7:55 pm Central, two weeks after it was supposed to happen. It’s the latest date in a long list of them. Tesla first showed the Roadster in November 2017 and promised production in 2020. Nearly nine years later, it hasn’t delivered a single one. more…

crypto.title: Coinbase, which holds 5% of all bitcoin, wants the quantum fix started now
crypto.description: Coinbase says bitcoin should start preparing for quantum computers now, with flexible addresses, a backup quantum-proof key and a separate debate over lost coins.

crypto.description: Chainalysis CEO in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

business.title: Softbank-backed bkash CEO On Digital Bank License
business.description: Kamal Quadir, the Founder & CEO of bKash, a mobile financial service provider in Bangladesh, says that approval to operate as a digital bank will ease the access to capital for the customers. He spoke to Yvonne Man at Bloomberg's New Economic Forum on AI, banking and more. (Source: Bloomberg)

space.title: Billionaire Mittal Says OneWeb Leads Musk in India Satcom Race
space.description: Indian tycoon Sunil Bharti Mittal said his Eutelsat OneWeb venture is “significantly ahead” of Starlink in India’s satellite-communication approval queue, amid Elon Musk’s criticism that some oligarchs are blocking his attempts to gain spectrum access in the country.

regulation.title: Qualcomm wins lawsuit against Arm but will only receive two bucks
regulation.description: A jury found that Arm breached its agreement with Qualcomm and interfered with its business, but Arm only has to pay $2 in damages.

regulation.title: Sunil Mittal Warns AI Is Outpacing Regulation
regulation.description: Sunil Mittal says governments are struggling to keep pace with the rapid pace of AI innovation, and suggests that regulation should provide guardrails without stifling innovation. (Source: Bloomberg)
